title: The sons of Rachava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: They are Ifa and Avimi, the sharp scholars of Pumbedita, as in Sanhedrin 17b. See their entries.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Davidson Sanhedrin 17b paragraph explicitly calls Ifa and Avimi the sons of Rachava and the sharp scholars of Pumbedita. The source’s collective direction is retained without importing other mnemonic groups. The individual cross-references remain unbound; this does not identify this Avimi with any separately published Avimi biography.
